case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to the rising cost of alloy and bar material, and we take that seriously.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On producer prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pairs a price in line with these falling cost lines with the longer term your planning benefits from.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Option A gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a binding contract for a longer term, a steady customer for its bar production and a clear price without further rounds of discussion. We would be glad if you would take Option A to that person.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Thank you for your help in bringing this to a good conclusion.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Regarding your request, please understand that it is our company policy not to share internal cost breakdowns.

We have verified the recent decreases in the alloy surcharge and producer prices, allowing us to reduce our price to EUR 5.40. We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms, provided we include the AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term material risks. 

Our offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, we can offer a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for checking the index changes and taking them into account. You asked for an index clause, but our options keep the price fixed with no clause, so the base price carries no cost-pressure premium on our side. Option A also gives you a longer contract term and a more favourable payment term than your current offer.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.86; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this goes beyond your own remit, could you please take Option A to the person who decides on your side?

We would be glad to settle this with you in a way that works for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have escalated your request to our management and reviewed your notes on our delivery performance. 

We cannot offer a fixed price for this duration and must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material risks. As a result, we can offer a reduced price of EUR 5.30 for a 24-month contract and 45-day payment terms.

Our main proposal stands at a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit for a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for volume and for protection against material costs, and our options answer the volume question directly: every one of them carries a binding annual volume over a full contract term, which gives your free capacity a firm base.

On the index clause, we have kept the price fixed in all options and without a clause. The base price therefore carries no cost-pressure premium on our side, and you get planning certainty for the whole term.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.91; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it combines the binding volume and the long contract with a payment term that works for both family companies. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

It is complete and can be approved as it stands.

Could you please take Option A to that person? We would be glad to see this settled in a way that is fair to both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
